north_star_goal: Make LumenCore the trusted proof-driven adaptive orchestration stack for complex systems: every claim is backed by reproducible data, every dashboard separates evidence from ambition, and every grant, contract, customer, or investor conversation can audit the work without needing a pitch.
operating_doctrine: Fail-closed execution before live capital or customer reliance.
Public-safe evidence for traction; private packets for submissions.
Dashboards show truth state, blockers, and next action instead of pretending gates are solved.
No geometry, algorithm, or route family is sacred until it wins under frozen evaluation.

builder_velocity.measurement_boundary: Rate is computed only from timestamped local artifacts in this feed. It is not a model benchmark, labor-cost estimate, revenue claim, or funding probability.

highest_leverage_milestones.target: Use the frozen NOAA AIS New Orleans / Mississippi River Delta dev/validation split and single-lane gate as the public representative-data bridge, then run the next HarborSentinel detector experiment without tuning on validation.
highest_leverage_milestones.traction_reason: This moves HarborSentinel beyond synthetic-only source readiness while still preserving the boundary that AIS single-lane diagnostics are not Navy field validation.

highest_leverage_milestones.target: Keep DICE locally locked, clear BAAT/SAM/user gates, and preserve the 7-page render/URL/cost-boundary lock packet.
highest_leverage_milestones.traction_reason: DARPA reviewers respect crisp boundaries, reproducible evidence, and no portal mistakes.

highest_leverage_milestones.target: Run nature/field/bio-network/LumenCore hybrids against frozen baselines on at least one representative dataset.
highest_leverage_milestones.traction_reason: Winning families become defensible research claims; losing families become credible negative evidence.

highest_leverage_milestones.target: Publish only sanitized dashboard feeds that show proof state, blockers, hashes, and next actions.
highest_leverage_milestones.traction_reason: Serious reviewers can audit the machine without seeing private applications or secrets.

highest_leverage_milestones.target: Convert proof packets into grant submissions, SBIR/BAA conversations, contract bids, paid pilots, and compliance-safe demos.
highest_leverage_milestones.traction_reason: Traction comes from buyers and agencies trusting the evidence chain, not from unsupported valuation language.

lumenstock.name: LumenStock Proof-Weighted Opportunity Index
lumenstock.interpretation: Internal proof/value readiness index. It is not equity, not a token, not a securities offering, not investment advice, and not a valuation.

next_72_hours: Package the NOAA AIS held-out split and public AIS gate into the HarborSentinel reviewer proof packet.
Run the next HarborSentinel detector experiment against the frozen public AIS split without threshold tuning on validation.
Hydrate grants dashboard with readiness, DICE lock, Harbor AIS, and builder velocity feeds.
Prepare public-safe proof cards for DICE/Harbor without private proposal text.
Use the LumenStock Proof-Weighted Opportunity Index as an internal prioritization meter only.
hard_boundaries: Do not represent LumenStock as stock, equity, a token, a public offering, or an investment product.
Do not claim guaranteed funding, guaranteed profit, field validation, CMMC certification, or institutional trading readiness.
Do not submit, certify, consent, upload, or move money without fresh action-time approval.
Do not commit raw AIS bulk data, secrets, credentials, private portal screenshots, or private application packets to public repos.
